checkoutIntro: Pay through WHY ME. Your money is held until you confirm you got what you paid for.
pickupHint: Agree the time and place with the seller in WHY ME chat.
deliveryHint: The seller arranges delivery. No delivery charge is added at checkout.
deliveryAddressHint: Only the seller sees this, and only after you pay.
deliveryNoteHint: No phone numbers or links: talk to the seller in WHY ME chat.
addressRequired: Enter the delivery address (at least 5 characters).
protectionTitle: How WHY ME Protected Payment works
protectionPay: You pay WHY ME, not the seller directly.
protectionHold: WHY ME holds the money while the seller gets your item to you.
protectionRelease: When you confirm you received it, WHY ME releases the money to the seller. If something is wrong, report a problem before you confirm and WHY ME reviews it.
protectionOutside: Never pay a seller outside WHY ME: those payments aren't protected.
acceptTerms: I have read the Protected Payment terms and agree to pay {{total}}.
acceptRequired: Tick the box to agree before paying.
payWith: You pay on Paystack's secure page by card (Visa, Mastercard, Verve) or bank transfer. WHY ME never sees your card details.
quoteFailed: Couldn't work out the total. Check your connection and try again.
unavailable: Protected checkout isn't open yet. You can message the seller in the meantime.
emptySoldTitle: Your next sale starts with a good listing.
emptyBoughtTitle: Your next good find is out there.
orderListSafety: Keep order updates, conversations and payments on WHY ME. Open an order to follow its progress and see what happens next.
ordersIntro: What you bought and sold through WHY ME Protected Payment.
emptyBought: No orders yet. Use "Buy with protection" on a product to order it.
emptySold: No paid orders yet. Orders show here once the buyer has paid.
loadFailed: Couldn't load orders. Check your connection.
orderLoadFailed: Couldn't load this order. Check your connection.

fulfilmentSeller.completion_submitted: Waiting for the buyer to confirm

paidBanner: Payment confirmed. WHY ME is holding {{total}} until you confirm you got your item.
paidNext: Next, the seller gets your item ready. Agree the details in chat, and come back here to confirm once you have it.
sellerPaidBanner: The buyer has paid {{total}}. WHY ME holds it and releases it to you after the buyer confirms they got the item.
sellerNext: Get the item ready and agree pickup or delivery with the buyer in chat. Never ask for payment outside WHY ME.
awaitingBanner: Not paid yet. Your order is saved; pay when you're ready.
pendingBanner: Your payment is being confirmed by the bank. This page updates by itself; don't pay again.
failedBanner: The last payment didn't go through, so no money was taken. You can try again.
reviewBanner: WHY ME is checking this payment with Paystack. Please don't pay again while we check.
pickupNote: Agree the time and place in chat.
attention: WHY ME support is looking at this order.
acceptHint: Accept only if you can supply it as described. The buyer has already paid; WHY ME holds the money until they confirm they got it.
declineHint: The buyer gets a full refund from WHY ME. Tell them why (they will see this).
noteHint: E.g. how it was sent and when it should arrive. No phone numbers or links.
sellerPaidNext: Accept the order, then get it ready. Agree pickup or delivery with the buyer in chat.
sellerAcceptedNext: When it is on its way (or ready for pickup), mark it here. Mark it delivered once the buyer has it.
sellerDispatchedNext: Mark it delivered once the buyer has it. They then confirm, and WHY ME releases your money.
sellerWaitingConfirm: Waiting for the buyer to confirm they got it. WHY ME releases your money after that.
sellerCompletedHeld: The buyer confirmed. WHY ME is checking this order before releasing your money.
sellerDeclined: You declined this order. WHY ME refunds the buyer.
buyerPaidWaiting: Payment confirmed. WHY ME is holding {{total}}. Waiting for the seller to accept your order.
buyerAccepted: The seller accepted your order and is getting it ready.
buyerDispatchedDelivery: The seller says your order is on its way.
buyerDispatchedPickup: The seller says your order is ready for pickup.
buyerDelivered: The seller says you have your order.
confirmHint: Confirm only when you have it and it is as described. WHY ME then releases {{total}} to the seller. This can't be undone.
confirmProblem: Something wrong? Don't confirm. Message the seller, or report the problem to WHY ME below.
buyerCompleted: You confirmed you got it. Thank you! WHY ME releases the payment to the seller.
buyerDeclined: The seller declined this order. Your {{total}} is still held by WHY ME and will be refunded to you. This page shows it when the refund is done.
buyerCancelled: You cancelled this order. Nothing was paid.
cancelQuestion: Cancel this order? You haven't paid, so nothing is charged.
changedMeanwhile: This order changed meanwhile. Here is the latest.

eventFunds.release_eligible: Ready for WHY ME to release

payBy: Pay by card or bank transfer

problem.reportIntro: Something wrong with this order? Tell WHY ME. We hold the money while we look into it, and the seller can reply here.
problem.title: What's wrong?

category.wrong_or_incomplete: Wrong item, or something is missing
category.quality: It's damaged or not as described
category.outside_payment: The seller asked me to pay outside WHY ME

problem.descriptionHint: At least 20 characters. No phone numbers or bank details: WHY ME can read your chat with the seller if needed.
problem.descriptionRequired: Tell us what happened (at least 20 characters).
problem.amountHint: Leave empty for the whole order ({{total}}).
problem.buyerActive: WHY ME is holding {{total}} while we look into this. You can add details below.
problem.sellerActive: The buyer reported a problem. WHY ME holds the money until it is sorted out. Give your side below.
problem.evidenceDue: WHY ME asked for evidence by {{date}}.
problem.addHint: No phone numbers, bank details or links.
problem.withdrawQuestion: Withdraw your report? WHY ME stops looking into it and the order carries on as before.

outcome.refund_full: WHY ME decided: a full refund of {{refund}} to the buyer, less Paystack's payment fee.
outcome.refund_partial: WHY ME decided: {{refund}} back to the buyer (less Paystack's payment fee); the rest goes to the seller.
outcome.release: WHY ME decided: the seller delivered as agreed, so the payment goes to the seller.
outcome.rework: WHY ME decided: the seller corrects or redoes it. The money stays held until the buyer confirms.

problem.refundFollows: The refund is made by WHY ME; this page shows it when it is done.
problem.confirmPaused: Confirming is paused while WHY ME looks into the problem you reported. Withdraw the report if everything is fine now.

refund.title: Refunds
refund.bankDelay: Banks can take up to 10 working days to show a refund on your account.
refund.failedNote: This refund didn't go through, so the money is still held by WHY ME. WHY ME will try again.
refund.needsAttentionNote: Your bank didn't send the account details Paystack needs to return the money. WHY ME is following it up.
refund.buyerRefunded: Refunded {{amount}} to the card or account you paid with.
refund.buyerOnItsWay: Your refund of {{amount}} is on its way. This page shows when Paystack confirms it.
refund.sellerRefunded: {{amount}} of this order is refunded to the buyer.
refund.sellerRest: WHY ME releases what is left to you after the refund is done.

payout.onItsWay: WHY ME released {{amount}} to you. It is on its way to your {{bank}} account ending {{last4}}.
payout.paid: Paid {{amount}} to your {{bank}} account ending {{last4}} on {{date}}.
payout.checking: WHY ME is checking your payout of {{amount}}. Nothing for you to do.
payout.loadFailed: Couldn't load what you'll be paid. Check your connection and try again.
payout.readyTitle: The buyer confirmed. You can be paid {{amount}}.
payout.requested: You asked WHY ME to pay you {{amount}} on {{date}}.
payout.requestedNext: WHY ME checks the order and sends the money to your bank. This page shows when it's on its way.
payout.declined: WHY ME didn't approve your last request: {{reason}}
payout.requestHint: Check the amounts before you ask. WHY ME staff approve every payout before it's sent.
payout.feesTitle: Paid by WHY ME, not you
payout.feesNote: These don't come off your money.

blocker.not_release_eligible: This order's money isn't ready to be paid out yet.
blocker.dispute_open: The buyer reported a problem. WHY ME decides it first.
blocker.refund_open: A refund on this order is in progress.
blocker.needs_staff: WHY ME is checking this order. Nothing for you to do.
blocker.seller_suspended: Your account is suspended, so payouts are paused. Contact WHY ME support.
blocker.seller_not_verified: Get your seller account verified to be paid.
blocker.no_payout_account: Add the bank account WHY ME pays you into.
blocker.payout_account_cooling_off: You changed your bank account recently. For your safety, payouts to it start a little later.
blocker.nothing_to_release: There's nothing left to pay out on this order.
blocker.other: This payout can't be requested yet.
